mapper.sql: select s.stock_id as stockId, s.enterprise_id as enterpriseId, s.product_id as productId, s.qty as qty, s.locked_qty as lockedQty, s.in_transit_qty as inTransitQty, s.qty - ifnull(s.locked_qty, 0) as availableQty, s.update_time as updateTime, p.product_code as productCode, p.product_name as productName, p.spec as spec, p.unit as unit, rp.safety_stock as safetyStock from t_stock s inner join t_product p on p.product_id = s.product_id and p.enterprise_id = s.enterprise_id and p.del_flag = '0' left join t_replenish_param rp on rp.product_id = s.product_id and rp.enterprise_id = s.enterprise_id
mapper.select: select stock_id as stockId, enterprise_id as enterpriseId, product_id as productId, qty as qty, locked_qty as lockedQty, in_transit_qty as inTransitQty, update_time as updateTime from t_stock where enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} and product_id = #{productId} for update
mapper.insert: insert into t_stock (enterprise_id, product_id, qty, locked_qty, in_transit_qty, update_time) values (#{enterpriseId}, #{productId}, #{qty}, 0, 0, sysdate())
mapper.update: update t_stock set qty = qty + #{qty}, update_time = sysdate() where enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} and product_id = #{productId}
update t_stock set in_transit_qty = in_transit_qty + #{qty}, update_time = sysdate() where enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} and product_id = #{productId}
